• Prüfung der GMP-Herstelldokumentationen für die Freigabe unserer Wirkstoffe
• Kontrollieren der Dokumentationen von Zwischen- und Endstufen auf GMP-Konformität und Übereinstimmung mit internen Vorschriften
• Besprechen von Auffälligkeiten mit den Ausführenden in den produzierenden Bereichen und Absprache der notwendigen Korrekturmassnahmen

• Umsetzen der GDP (Good Distribution Practice) Richtlinien im Bereich der Bereitstellung, der Handhabung und des Vertriebs unserer GMP-Produkte Ihr Profil:
• Berufslehre als Chemielaborant/in, Chemisch-technische/r Assistent/in (CTA), Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe/in oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
• Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung innerhalb der chemisch-/pharmazeutischen Industrie, vorzugsweise im GMP-Umfeld resp. in der Kontrolle von GMP-Herstelldokumentationen
• Sie sind gewohnt, Dokumente zu erstellen, zu prüfen und Korrekturmassnahmen durchzusetzen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit elektronischen Qualitätsmanagementsystemen von Vorteil
• Sie sind eine selbständige und verantwortungsbewusste Person mit einer sorgfältigen und teamorientierten Arbeitsweise und hohem Verständnis von Qualitätssicherungsaspekten

• Sie haben Interesse und Erfahrung an/mit elektronischen Systemen für Chargendokumentation (MES) und einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office. SAP Kenntnisse von Vorteil Unser Angebot:

To strengthen our Regulatory Affairs (RA) team, we are looking for a (Senior) Regulatory Affairs Manager (permanent position, 100%, f/m/d). You will take full responsibility for your assigned projects/tasks while benefiting from working within a highly motivated and innovative team. Your tasks
• Representation of RA in projects, including discussions and negotiations with the customers during the whole product lifecycle, i.e, from pre-clinical to marketed.
• Close cross-functional collaboration with a high diversity of internal stakeholders.
• Development and tailoring of convincing regulatory strategies.
• Delivery of regulatory advice to internal and external stakeholders.
• Hands-on writing and review of regulatory documents and dossiers in accordance with customer requirements and applicable regulatory rules and guidelines. The documents may have different backgrounds, e.g.,
• Life-cycle phase from clinical Phases I-III or market purpose (e.g., NDA)
• Peptide and oligonucleotide APIs
• Target markets, e.g., US, EU, JP, CN, BR
• Coordination of responses to authority requests in close collaboration with our customers.
• Steering of site-overarching initiatives for improvement and innovation while proactively anticipating challenging situations.
• Management of internal and external stakeholders to reach regulatory objectives while demonstrating high degree of integrity, reliability, resilience, tenacity, openness and collaborative spirit.
• Coaching other RA members, as well as actively contributing to the knowledge-building and -transfer within the team. Your profile
• University degree Master and/or PhD with focus on Natural Sciences (Chemistry, Pharmacy, or similar field).
• At least 5 years of professional experience in an RA function. Experience with regulatory requirements for drug substances is a plus.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills supporting successful and efficient exchange with internal stakeholders, customers, and regulatory agencies based on a business mindset.
• Experience in supervising complex projects and tasks and in establishing regulatory strategies.
• Flair for creating high-quality output ranging from convincing presentations to on-point drug substance CMC sections of regulatory dossiers.
• Critical thinker with a lot of curiosity and a knack for creative solutions.
• Fluent and persuasive in English (C1) – German as a plus. Our offer:
• An empowered key position in an exciting, challenging, and highly dynamic environment that guarantees a wide range of activities.
• You will join a team of international specialists that will help nurture your professional growth.
• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction.
• Employee development through internal and external training opportunities.
• Modern terms of employment and attractive fringe benefits. Interested? We look forward to receiving your complete application package (e.g., motivation letter, CV, testimonials, diploma) online via our Application Portal. At Bachem , you’ll find a diverse, multicultural team. The (a) in the job title stands for all . We welcome applications from all candidates. What matters are your skills and motivation—regardless of age, gender, background, religion, or sexual orientation. Please note: unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies will not be considered. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Pour stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe d'Affaires réglementaires (AR), nous cherchons un gestionnaire principal des Affaires réglementaires (poste permanent, 100 %, f/m/j). Vous assumerez l'entière responsabilité de vos projets/tâches assignés tout en bénéficiant de travailler au sein d'une équipe hautement motivée et innovante.
• Vos tâches Représentation de la RA dans les projets, y compris les discussions et les négociations avec les clients pendant tout le cycle de vie du produit, c'est-à-dire de préclinique à commercialisé. Une collaboration interfonctionnelle étroite avec une grande diversité d'intervenants internes. Élaboration et adaptation de stratégies réglementaires convaincantes. Prestation de conseils réglementaires aux intervenants internes et externes. Rédiger et examiner les documents et dossiers réglementaires conformément aux exigences du client et aux règles et lignes directrices réglementaires applicables. Les documents peuvent avoir des antécédents différents, p. ex., phase du cycle de vie à partir des phases cliniques I à III ou objectif du marché (p. ex., NDA) Peptide et oligonucléotides API Marchés cibles, p. ex., États-Unis, UE, JP, CN, BR Coordination des réponses aux demandes d'autorisation en étroite collaboration avec nos clients. L'orientation des initiatives d'amélioration et d'innovation sur place tout en anticipant de façon proactive les situations difficiles. Gestion des intervenants internes et externes pour atteindre les objectifs réglementaires tout en démontrant un haut degré d'intégrité, de fiabilité, de résilience, de ténacité, d'ouverture et d'esprit de collaboration. Entraîner d'autres membres de l'AR, ainsi que contribuer activement au renforcement des connaissances et au transfert au sein de l'équipe.
• Votre profil Maîtrise universitaire et/ou doctorat en sciences naturelles (chimie, pharmacie ou domaine similaire). Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction de RA. L'expérience des exigences réglementaires pour les substances médicamenteuses est un plus. Des compétences de communication et de collaboration solides qui favorisent des échanges fructueux et efficaces avec les intervenants internes, les clients et les organismes de réglementation en fonction d'un état d'esprit d'entreprise. Expérience de la supervision de projets et de tâches complexes et de l'établissement de stratégies réglementaires. Flair pour la création d'un rendement de haute qualité allant des présentations convaincantes à la substance médicamenteuse sur le point CMC sections de dossiers réglementaires. Penseur critique avec beaucoup de curiosité et un knack pour des solutions créatives. Fluent et persuasif en anglais (C1) – allemand en plus. Notre offre : Une position clé autonomisée dans un environnement passionnant, stimulant et très dynamique qui garantit un large éventail d'activités. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe de spécialistes internationaux qui favorisera votre développement professionnel. Des heures de travail flexibles avec les jours de bureau à domicile et une option pour obtenir des jours de vacances supplémentaires grâce à la réduction de la charge de travail. Développement des employés grâce à des possibilités de formation internes et externes. Conditions d'emploi modernes et avantages marginaux attrayants. Intéressé ? Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre dossier de candidature complet (p. ex. lettre de motivation, CV, témoignages, diplôme) en ligne via notre portail d'applications. Chez Bachem, vous trouverez une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle. Le (a) dans le titre d'emploi représente pour tous . Nous accueillons les candidatures de tous les candidats. Ce qui compte, ce sont vos compétences et votre motivation, peu importe l'âge, le sexe, l'origine, la religion ou l'orientation sexuelle. Veuillez noter que les curriculum vitae non sollicités des agences de recrutement ne seront pas pris en considération. Partagez cette offre d'emploi par courriel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per rafforzare la leadership dell'eccellenza operativa del nostro sito, stiamo cercando un partner commerciale OE esperto e visionario per il nostro sito di Bubendorf. In questa posizione chiave, modellerai ed eseguirai la strategia di eccellenza operativa specifica del sito di Bachem, promuovendo una cultura di miglioramento continuo e impatto aziendale misurabile in tutte le funzioni. In qualità di interfaccia principale tra il sito e l'OE globale, guiderai iniziative OE, promuoverai l'innovazione e svilupperai capacità OE a ogni livello.
• I tuoi compiti Guidare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la sostenibilità del programma Operational Excellence (OE) a livello di sito, traducendo la strategia e gli standard OE globali in un impatto locale misurabile. Gestire la roadmap OE del sito e il portafoglio di miglioramenti, guidando iniziative interfunzionali per fornire risultati in termini di produttività, qualità, sicurezza, costi e consegna. Costruisci capacità e cultura OE attraverso il coaching, il tutoraggio e la leadership del cambiamento, coinvolgendo i dipendenti a tutti i livelli, guidando la governance e lo sviluppo della rete locale di campioni OE. Garantisci un monitoraggio disciplinato delle prestazioni, la trasparenza dei vantaggi e la conformità agli standard di qualità, normativi e di sicurezza. Agire come consulente di fiducia per la leadership del sito e come interfaccia chiave per l'organizzazione globale OE, condividendo le migliori pratiche e promuovendo l'innovazione. Il tuo profilo Laurea universitaria (preferibilmente Master / Dottorato di ricerca / MBA) in ingegneria, chimica, produzione, gestione delle operazioni o campo correlato. 10 anni di esperienza nell'eccellenza operativa, nel miglioramento dei processi o nella gestione della produzione, idealmente in ambienti CDMO/CMO, chimici o farmaceutici. Comprovata esperienza nella conduzione di iniziative di trasformazione OE su larga scala con un impatto aziendale misurabile e duraturo. Lean Six Sigma Green o Black Belt (preferibilmente cintura nera); forte esperienza nelle metodologie di miglioramento continuo. Eccellenti capacità di leadership, comunicazione e relazioni interpersonali; capacità di influenzare e motivare a tutti i livelli. La conoscenza della lingua inglese (C1) e tedesca (C1) è obbligatoria. La nostra offerta Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno Supporto attraverso opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna Contributo del datore di lavoro al 60% al fondo pensione e possibilità di ulteriori risparmi volontari Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggi Swibeco con sconti presso partner esterni Pasti freschi e sani nel nostro ristorante per i dipendenti e una varietà di attività sportive gratuite nel campus Interessato? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i documenti di candidatura completi tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e sul nostro ambiente di lavoro presso la sede di Bubendorf sul nostro sito web. Nota: i curriculum non richiesti dalle agenzie di reclutamento non verranno presi in considerazione. Condividi questo annuncio di lavoro via e-mail
descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our site operational excellence leadership, we are seeking an experienced and visionary OE Business Partner for our Bubendorf site. In this key position, you will shape and execute Bachem’s site-specific Operational Excellence strategy, driving a culture of continuous improvement and measurable business impact across all functions. As the primary interface between site and global OE, you will lead OE initiatives, foster innovation, and build OE capability at every level. Your tasks
• Drive the design, execution, and sustainability of the Operational Excellence (OE) program at site level, translating global OE strategy and standards into measurable local impact.
• Own the site OE roadmap and improvement portfolio, leading cross-functional initiatives to deliver results in productivity, quality, safety, cost, and delivery.
• Build OE capability and culture through coaching, mentoring, and change leadership - engaging employees at all levels, drive governance and development of local OE champions network.
• Ensure disciplined performance tracking, benefits transparency, and compliance with quality, regulatory, and safety standards.
• Act as a trusted advisor to site leadership and a key interface to the Global OE organization, sharing best practices and fostering innovation. Your Profile
• University degree (Master/PhD/MBA preferred) in Engineering, Chemistry, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or related field.
• 10+ years’ experience in Operational Excellence, process improvement, or manufacturing management, ideally in CDMO/CMO, chemical or pharmaceutical environments.
• Proven track record in leading large-scale OE transformation initiatives with measurable, sustained business impact.
• Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt (Black Belt preferred); strong expertise in continuous improvement methodologies.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to influence and motivate at all levels.
• Fluency in English (C1) and German (C1) is mandatory. Our offer
• A dynamic and growing work environment with internal development opportunities
• Support through internal and external training opportunities
• 60% employer contribution to the pension fund and the option for additional voluntary savings
• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts at external partners
• Fresh, healthy meals in our staff restaurant and a variety of free sports activities on campus Interested? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and our working environment at the Bubendorf site on our website. At Bachem , you’ll find a diverse, multicultural team. The (a) in the job title stands for all . We welcome applications from all candidates. descriptionByLocale.de:
Zur Stärkung unserer Standortführerschaft im Bereich Operational Excellence suchen wir einen erfahrenen und visionären OE Business Partner für unseren Standort Bubendorf. In dieser Schlüsselposition werden Sie die standortspezifische Operational Excellence-Strategie von Bachem gestalten und umsetzen und so eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und messbaren Geschäftsauswirkungen in allen Funktionen vorantreiben. Als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen Standort und globalem OE leiten Sie OE-Initiativen, fördern Innovationen und bauen OE-Fähigkeiten auf allen Ebenen auf.
• Ihre Aufgaben: Fördern Sie das Design, die Umsetzung und die Nachhaltigkeit des Operational Excellence (OE)-Programms auf Standortebene und setzen Sie die globale OE-Strategie und -Standards in messbare lokale Auswirkungen um. Besitzen Sie die OE-Roadmap und das Verbesserungsportfolio des Standorts und leiten Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen, um Ergebnisse in Bezug auf Produktivität, Qualität, Sicherheit, Kosten und Lieferung zu erzielen. Bauen Sie OE-Fähigkeiten und -Kultur durch Coaching, Mentoring und Change Leadership auf – binden Sie Mitarbeiter auf allen Ebenen ein, treiben Sie die Governance und Entwicklung des lokalen OE-Champions-Netzwerks voran. Sorgen Sie für eine disziplinierte Leistungsverfolgung, Leistungstransparenz und die Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Regulierungs- und Sicherheitsstandards. Fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Standortleitung und als wichtige Schnittstelle zur globalen OE-Organisation, indem Sie Best Practices austauschen und Innovationen fördern.
• Ihr Profil Hochschulabschluss (Master/PhD/MBA bevorzugt) in Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Fertigung, Betriebsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich. 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Operational Excellence, Prozessverbesserung oder Fertigungsmanagement, idealerweise im CDMO/CMO-, Chemie- oder Pharmaumfeld. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Leitung groß angelegter OE-Transformationsinitiativen mit messbaren, nachhaltigen Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft. Lean Six Sigma Green oder Black Belt (Schwarzer Gürtel bevorzugt); ausgeprägte Expertise in Methoden zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung. descriptionByLocale.en:
To further strengthen our global Operational Excellence team, we are seeking a hands‑on and pragmatic Global OE Specialist - Lean. In this key global role, you will act as a subject‑matter expert and authority for Lean systems and flow excellence, driving measurable and sustainable improvements in flow, throughput, lead time, and productivity across production and transactional environments worldwide. Your responsibilities
• Lead and/or support high‑impact Lean initiatives across sites and functions (manufacturing, supply chain, quality interfaces, and transactional processes)
• Own, deploy, and continuously improve Lean systems and standards (e.g. Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, SMED, Visual Management, TPM foundations) within the global OE operating model
• Drive end‑to‑end value‑stream optimization to improve flow, increase throughput, and reduce lead time from demand to delivery
• Enable systematic identification and elimination of losses and waste in direct and indirect processes, including bottleneck analysis and flow‑based optimization
• Ensure Lean initiatives translate into robust problem‑solving actions, standardization, and sustainable control mechanisms
• Provide hands‑on on‑site and remote support for continuous improvement events, value‑stream transformations, and stabilization phases
• Build Lean capability by coaching site leadership, OE Business Partners, and OE Champions in Lean leadership behaviors and practical application of Lean methods
• Contribute to the OE Academy through development and delivery of Lean trainings, role‑based curricula, and sharing of best practices across the global OE community
• Support OE governance and portfolio execution through maturity assessments, standard adherence, clear baselining, and tracking of sustainable benefits
• Collaborate closely with other Global OE Specialists to integrate approaches and ensure a coherent, non‑fragmented OE system Your Profile:
• University degree in chemistry, engineering, pharmaceutical or natural sciences, or a related field
• At least 5 years professional experience in Lean deployment, operational excellence, and/or continuous improvement roles, ideally in CDMO/CMO, chemical/pharmaceutical manufacturing environments
• Professional experience in GMP regulated environments is a advantage
• Proven track record leading value‑stream transformations and delivering measurable improvements in flow, lead time, and productivity
• Lean certification preferred (e.g. Lean Leader, Lean Expert, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with strong Lean focus). Exposure to Master Black Belt concepts is a plus
• Strong facilitation, coaching, and stakeholder‑management skills across cultures and seniority levels
• Ability to translate Lean standards into practical application and enable adoption at scale
• Excellent written and spoken English (C1) and German (C1) is mandatory
• Willingness to travel approx. 10–30%, depending on footprint and project pipeline, for global coordination, training delivery, and site support Would you like to drive operational excellence with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and our working environment at the Bubendorf site on our website. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT, Security and Compliance (S&C) department, we are seeking an experienced IAM & Access Control Engineer (a), 100%. Reporting to the Head of Security Operation and Architecture and working within the CISO organization, you will reinforce the existing IAM platform ownership and management capabilities. This role complements and reinforces the existing IAM platform capabilities by bringing additional depth in access control enforcement, privileged access hardening and Zero Trust implementation. Our Identity team operates the One Identity platform and Microsoft Entra ID as the central control layer governing authentication, authorization, and privileged access across IT, OT, laboratory, and cloud environments. You will strengthen our identity governance capabilities with a strong focus on One Identity Manager, while contributing to access control enforcement and the evolution of our identity security model. Your tasks: This role focuses on identity governance and platform engineering rather than operational access request handling:
• Operate, extend and optimize the One Identity platform by onboarding new applications and entitlements into the governance model.
• Design, implement and optimize identity governance workflows, role models and target system integrations within One Identity Manager.
• Collaborate with external developers and internal stakeholders to evolve and maintain the One Identity platform.
• Improve identity data quality, reconciliation processes and entitlement structures.
• Support the design and implementation of Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra ID and contribute to authentication hardening initiatives.
• Integrate applications into SSO (SAML/OIDC) and standardize strong authentication mechanisms (MFA, step-up authentication).
• Support the implementation of Privileged Access and PIM capabilities as part of the broader identity security roadmap.
• Contribute to the organization’s Zero Trust journey by enforcing least-privilege principles and improving governance of human and non-human identities.
• Reduce permanent administrative privileges and implement time-bound, approval-based privileged access workflows.
• Secure service accounts and non-human identities and eliminate legacy authentication patterns.
• Align technical entitlements with business role models and support segregation-of-duties enforcement.
• Identify and remediate excessive permissions, privilege persistence and legacy authentication risks.
• Automate access enforcement, remediation workflows and identity-related security controls.
• Collaborate with IT, OT and business stakeholders to harden authentication patterns across infrastructure, cloud and production systems.
• Support audits and compliance initiatives by ensuring enforceable and demonstrable access governance controls (ISO 27001, GxP, NIS2).

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you about to look for an apprenticeship and are you interested in a trial day as a laboratory technician specializing in chemistry? Then you've come to the right place!
• Job description The job of laboratory technician specializing in chemistry is divided into two specialist areas: Synthesis At Bachem AG, you produce a variety of new peptides, amino acid derivatives and other organic substances and compounds from two or more starting materials. Laboratory technicians calculate the quantities of starting materials to be used and let them react with each other. They isolate the desired product from the reaction mixture and then purify the raw product obtained. The substances produced in this way are analyzed for quantity, quality and composition. In the course with a focus on synthesis, particular emphasis is placed on the production of substances. Laboratory technicians work in teams using a variety of glass apparatus and computer-assisted devices. All work steps and reaction processes are closely observed and recorded so that the work contributes to ongoing process improvement. Analytics Laboratory technicians with a focus on analytics are mainly active in quality control (QC). They accompany the entire flow of goods through the company. During incoming inspection, the raw materials are checked for their identity, purity and other criteria. During the course of a synthesis, additional analyzes are carried out for the producing areas using a variety of methods. Once a product is finished, it is subjected to a detailed final analysis (final inspection) by the QC, during which all previously defined quality requirements are checked. These analyzes generate a large number of results, which the laboratory technicians then evaluate, process, convert and compare. Handling small sample quantities, working with sometimes highly complex, computer-controlled devices, and evaluating results with highly specific software are part of everyday life.
• Your profile Interest in scientific processes Logical and networked thinking Good observation skills as well as precise and clean work A team player, reliable, flexible personality Endurance and physical resilience Process On this day we will show you how exciting and varied this job is. The trainees will take you to their line positions so you can ask all your questions straight away. The day starts with an insight into synthesis and, after lunch together, we continue with analysis. To apply to us, we ask you to upload scans/photocopies of the following documents: Current certificate <li

titleByLocale.fr: Chimiste (h/f/e) Oligonucléotide, Temps plein

descriptionByLocale.it: Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel reparto pilota dei principi attivi, cerchiamo un chimico impegnato (f/m/d), al 100%. Nel nostro impianto di produzione producete oligonucleotidi farmaceuticamente efficaci e sostanze correlate. Lavori in condizioni GMP e utilizzi moderni sistemi di produzione dalla produzione alla purificazione. Attraverso la formazione orientata alla pratica, acquisirai la sicurezza necessaria per lavorare in modo indipendente e responsabile sui nostri sistemi di produzione e diventare parte del nostro team. Se per te è importante lavorare con noi oltre il tuo lavoro quotidiano per migliorare continuamente i nostri impianti di produzione e i nostri processi lavorativi e apprezzi l'opportunità di contribuire con la tua esperienza in questo modo, allora sei nel posto giusto. I vostri compiti: pianificate, controllate e monitorate i nostri processi di produzione nell'interfaccia con la ricerca e sviluppo nel rispetto delle specifiche e delle scadenze. Preparate la documentazione del lotto per l'esecuzione, documentatela in conformità con le GMP e assicuratevi che sia completata correttamente e in tempo. Siete presenti durante le fasi critiche del processo e prendete decisioni per l'ulteriore corso della produzione. In caso di risultati imprevisti, problemi alle apparecchiature o carenze di conformità, avviare e coordinare le misure appropriate. Identifichi attivamente il potenziale di miglioramento nella tua area di responsabilità e implementi le misure appropriate in modo indipendente. Ordinate puntualmente la giusta quantità di attrezzature, solventi e materie prime per le campagne di produzione dalla catena di fornitura. Sei responsabile delle norme di manutenzione e pulizia delle apparecchiature e dei sistemi, nonché della loro implementazione. Procurate e qualificate le attrezzature di produzione. Avviano controlli e campioni durante il processo e interpretano i risultati. Il tuo profilo: Laurea in chimica (università o istituto tecnico). Hai una buona conoscenza delle relazioni tecniche e dei sistemi automatizzati. Ti piace assumerti responsabilità e sei caratterizzato da un elevato livello di affidabilità, indipendenza e capacità di lavorare in squadra. Flessibilità, comunicazione e volontà di apprendere sono tra i tuoi punti di forza. Un modo di lavorare strutturato, pulito e indipendente che ti permette di avere sempre tutto sotto controllo. Ottimo tedesco e Gu
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team in the active ingredient pilot department, we are looking for a committed chemist (f/m/d), 100%. In our production facility you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production systems from production to purification. Through the practice-oriented training, you will gain the necessary confidence to work independently and responsibly on our production systems and become part of our team. If it is important to you to work with us beyond your daily work to continually improve our production facilities and work processes and you value the opportunity to contribute your experience in this way, then you have come to the right place.
• Your tasks: You plan, control and monitor our manufacturing processes at the interface to R&D in compliance with specifications and deadlines. You prepare the batch documentation for execution, document in accordance with GMP and ensure that it is completed correctly and on time. You are present during critical process steps and make decisions for the further course of production. In the event of unexpected results, equipment problems or compliance deficiencies, initiate and coordinate the appropriate measures. You actively identify potential for improvement in your area of ​​responsibility and implement appropriate measures independently. You order the right amount of equipment, solvents and raw materials for the manufacturing campaigns from Supply Chain on time. You are responsible for the maintenance and cleaning regulations for the equipment and systems as well as their implementation. You procure and qualify production equipment. They initiate in-process controls and samples and interpret the results.
• Your profile: Completed chemistry degree (university or technical college). You have a good understanding of technical relationships and automated systems. You enjoy taking on responsibility and are characterized by a high level of reliability, independence and the ability to work in a team. Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths. A structured, clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times. Very good German and Gu
descriptionByLocale.de: Chemiker/in Oligo (a), 100% bei Bachem AG in Bubendorf. Bachem AG ist ein etablierter Schweizer Gesundheitsdienstleister. Diese Stelle bietet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Afin de soutenir notre croissance organique continue, nous sommes constamment à la recherche de spécialistes hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe dans le département pilote de principes actifs, nous recherchons un chimiste engagé (f/m/d), 100%. Dans notre site de production, vous produisez des oligonucléotides et des substances associées pharmaceutiquement efficaces. Vous travaillez dans des conditions GMP et utilisez des systèmes de production modernes, de la production à la purification. Grâce à la formation axée sur la pratique, vous acquerrez la confiance nécessaire pour travailler de manière indépendante et responsable sur nos systèmes de production et faire partie de notre équipe. S'il est important pour vous de travailler avec nous au-delà de votre travail quotidien pour améliorer continuellement nos installations de production et nos processus de travail et que vous appréciez l'opportunité de partager votre expérience de cette manière, alors vous êtes au bon endroit.
• Vos missions : Vous planifiez, contrôlez et suivez nos processus de fabrication à l'interface avec la R&D dans le respect des spécifications et des délais. Vous préparez la documentation du lot pour l'exécution, la documentez conformément aux BPF et veillez à ce qu'elle soit complétée correctement et dans les délais. Vous êtes présent lors des étapes critiques du processus et prenez des décisions pour la suite de la production. En cas de résultats inattendus, de problèmes d’équipement ou de défauts de conformité, initier et coordonner les mesures appropriées. Vous identifiez activement les potentiels d'amélioration dans votre domaine de responsabilité et mettez en œuvre les mesures appropriées de manière indépendante. Vous commandez à temps auprès de la Supply Chain la bonne quantité d’équipements, de solvants et de matières premières pour les campagnes de fabrication. Vous êtes responsable des règles d’entretien et de nettoyage des équipements et systèmes ainsi que de leur mise en œuvre. Vous achetez et qualifiez les équipements de production. Ils lancent des contrôles et des échantillons en cours de processus et interprètent les résultats.
• Votre profil : Diplôme complété en chimie (université ou école technique). Vous avez une bonne compréhension des relations techniques et des systèmes automatisés. Vous aimez assumer des responsabilités et vous caractérisez par un haut niveau de fiabilité, d'indépendance et une capacité à travailler en équipe. La flexibilité, la communication et la volonté d’apprendre font partie de vos points forts. Une manière de travailler structurée, propre et indépendante qui vous permet de garder une vue d'ensemble à tout moment. Très bon allemand et Gu

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Communications Business Partner (f/m/d), 80–100%, with the skills and motivation to independently support our businesses in all areas of communications. The position reports to the Head of Group Communications and External Affairs and is located in Bubendorf/CH.
• Your tasks: Acts as a business partner in the Group Communications and External Affairs team, supporting business priorities and projects across all internal and external channels (incl. digital, social media and events) Drives integrated, channel‑agnostic communication execution, ensuring consistent narratives, messages and tone across all touchpoints Translates business topics and milestones into clear, audience‑appropriate communication content, aligned with communication strategy, brand guidelines and governance Develops and coordinates multi‑channel communication assets (e.g. articles, presentations, visuals, social‑media‑ready content) in close collaboration with Group Communications channel and topic leads Supports global communication coordination across the group’s locations, enabling consistent messaging and effective localization Prepares and supports global leadership meetings and provides project support for key events such as Capital Market Day, Financial Results and Annual General Meeting, contributing to storyline, content and cross‑channel delivery

descriptionByLocale.it: Stai per cercare un tirocinio e sei interessato ad una giornata di prova come ingegnere dell'automazione? Allora sei nel posto giusto! Descrizione del lavoro In qualità di ingegnere dell'automazione, lavori nei settori della tecnologia e della manutenzione. Ti assicuri che i sistemi produttivi e infrastrutturali funzionino correttamente. Implementate ottimizzazioni e miglioramenti tecnici ai nostri sistemi, vi occupate dei controlli e dei sistemi elettrici e pneumatici o programmate un PLC o la visualizzazione di un sistema. Anche la risoluzione dei problemi dei nostri sistemi e sistemi complessi, nonché la comprensione delle connessioni tra i processi di produzione e i controlli, fanno parte di questo entusiasmante lavoro. Con noi, offre un'ampia gamma di compiti nella produzione di farmaci con le più moderne attrezzature in un ambiente di lavoro innovativo. descriptionByLocale.it: Per far progredire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team nella dispensazione, siamo alla ricerca di un dipendente dedicato*in dispensazione (w/m/d) al 100% nel funzionamento a turni (strato di rottura/shot) I vostri compiti: Postazione esatta di materie prime chimiche solide e liquide, tra e prodotti finali Alcuni lavori e logging delle attività svolte Fornire gli utensili necessari per il lavoro di porzionatura Tuttavia, accettiamo anche dossier di candidati e candidati con esperienza professionale nell'ambiente regolamentato (Chemie, Pharma, Food, ecc.) L'esperienza con attività nella stanza pulita e il lavoro sotto GMP è auspicabile, ma non necessariamente Sono estremamente affidabili, lavorano in modo indipendente e sono fisicamente resilienti Hai una procedura strutturata che ti permette di tenere una panoramica in qualsiasi momento Le tue competenze tedesche sono buone La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con ulteriori possibilità di sviluppo interne Supporto dei dipendenti attraverso numerose offerte di formazione interna ed esterna 60% di acquisizione dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e possibilità di precauzioni sovraobbligatorie con il nostro piano elettorale Accesso alla piattaforma di benefici Swibeco con sconti da parte di partner esterni Quindi non vediamo l'ora che i tuoi documenti applicativi siano completi tramite il nostro portale. Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro stimolante nel nostro sito Bubendorf! Traduzione:

To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. In order to strengthen our team in the dispensation, we are looking for a dedicated employee*in dispensation (w/m/d) 100% in shift operation (break/shot layer)
• Your tasks: Exact posting of solid and liquid chemical raw materials, between and final products Certain work and logging of the performed activities Provide the necessary utensils for portioning work However, we also accept dossiers of candidates and candidates with professional experience in the regulated environment (Chemie, Pharma, Food, etc.) Experience with activities in the clean room and work under GMP is desirable, but not necessarily They are extremely reliable, work independently and are physically resilient You have a structured procedure that allows you to keep an overview at any time Your German skills are good Our offer: A dynamic and growing working environment with internal further development possibilities Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers 60% takeover of pension funds contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory precautions with our electoral plan Access to the benefit platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our personal restaurant Various free sports activities on the Bachem campus Did we awaken your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our inspiring work environment at our Bubendorf site! <

titleByLocale.fr: Global Marketing Analyste (f/m/d), 100%

descriptionByLocale.it: Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel reparto Commerciale, stiamo cercando un Global Marketing Analyst dedicato (f/m/d), 100%. Afin de renforcer davantage notre organisation mondiale des opérations techniques et de créer un impact commercial, nous recrutons un responsable technologique mondial pour les plates-formes de séchage par pulvérisation – MS&T. Il s'agit d'un rôle de premier plan et d'impact élevé sur le leadership technologique mondial avec une forte visibilité dans les opérations techniques et l'ingénierie. Il agit en tant qu'autorité technique mondiale pour le séchage par pulvérisation dans l'ensemble du groupe Bachem, responsable de la stratégie technologique, des normes, de la gérance du cycle de vie et du déploiement évolutif sur tous les sites. En possédant la technologie à l'échelle mondiale, ce rôle établit des normes et prend des décisions tout en étant propriétaire de tout le cycle de vie, de l'innovation et de la conception à la fabrication courante, assurant ainsi une exécution et une conformité robustes et évolutives des BPF. Ce rôle est créé dans une phase d'accumulation, offrant la possibilité de façonner le mandat, la gouvernance et le modèle opérationnel. Le rôle est également d'appuyer les unités opérationnelles par un appui pratique pendant la mise en oeuvre de la nouvelle technologie.
• Vos responsabilités:Propriété et amélioration continue de la plate-forme technologique globale de séchage des pulvérisations (normes, gérance du cycle de vie, objectifs de performance et feuille de route des capacités). Interaction étroite avec les équipes de projet CAPEX et CMC, avec prise en charge correspondante des responsabilités au sein de ces équipes pour mettre en œuvre la technologie à temps et en conformité avec les exigences de qualité. Responsable des décisions technologiques mondiales de séchage par pulvérisation, y compris les normes de procédé, l'acceptation des risques techniques et les écarts justifiés Établit des normes mondiales et sert de point d'escalade pour les questions techniques complexes de séchage par pulvérisation. Possède le cadre pertinent, comme la documentation connexe. Définir et maintenir des pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle mondiale pour le séchage par pulvérisation, y compris la conception des procédés, l'approche à l'échelle, les principes du RPC/stratégie de contrôle, les concepts de nettoyage et la capacité de qualification/validation. Plomb et soutien du transfert de technologie et de l'industrialisation des procédés de séchage par pulvérisation depuis le développement ou le projet pilote jusqu'à la fabrication de BPF. Agir comme autorité technique pour le dépannage, les enquêtes et l'amélioration de la robustesse dans tous les sites. Établir des normes mondiales pour l'évaluation, la sélection et la spécification des équipements; collaborer étroitement avec Ingénierie et Fabrication sur les intrants de conception et les exigences opérationnelles. Agir en tant que chef de file technique mondial pour le séchage par pulvérisation dans les projets CAPEX et CMC en veillant à ce que les choix de la technologie de séchage par pulvérisation soutiennent l'évolutivité, la conformité et l'excellence opérationnelle. Collaborer avec la fabrication, l'OT, la fabrication numérique et la science des données, et la qualité pour assurer l'exécution cohérente des BPF et la préparation à l'inspection pour les sujets du séchage par pulvérisation. Diriger l'exécution par le biais de projets et de flux de travail transfonctionnels, mobiliser les parties prenantes par le biais de la matrice et de la direction latérale. Établir un partage structuré des connaissances (lignes directrices, modèles, leçons apprises, concepts de formation, communauté d'experts). Permettre la surveillance des processus axée sur les données et l'amélioration continue par des examens structurés et des tendances.
• Votre profil : Maîtrise ou doctorat en génie chimique, chimie, sciences pharmaceutiques ou domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou CDMO qui ont une responsabilité progressive dans la S-T, les opérations techniques ou les fonctions de leadership en matière de plate-forme ou de technologie. Une solide expérience industrielle pratique dans le séchage par pulvérisation dans des environnements de fabrication réglementés; une expérience pharmaceutique ou CDMO fortement préférée. Expérience démontrée en matière d'expansion, de transfert de technologie et d'industrialisation des procédés de séchage par pulvérisation. Capacité éprouvée de diriger des sujets complexes à travers des projets et un leadership latéral sans rapport direct. Expérience de travail dans des environnements mondiaux, multi-sites, inter-fonctionnels. Expertise approfondie dans les opérations des unités de séchage par pulvérisation, les considérations de conception de l'équipement et la robustesse du processus. Connaissance approfondie des exigences des BPF et des attentes en matière de qualification et de validation. Gestion technique solide des risques et stratégie de contrôle. Excellent anglais écrit et parlé (C1) est obligatoire. La compétence allemande est fortement préférée pour interagir sur le terrain sur le site de Bubendorf. Volonté d'accommoder la collaboration et les déplacements mondiaux d'environ 20 à 30 %, selon le pipeline et la phase du projet Notre offre : Ce rôle offre une large visibilité à l'échelle mondiale dans le domaine des opérations techniques et des plateformes d'innovation et une collaboration étroite avec les principaux intervenants. Elle permettra une forte visibilité professionnelle et offrira l'occasion de façonner à long terme l'innovation à l'échelle du groupe. Ce rôle fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale avec un accent initial sur Switzerlan
